sentences.text: John Herschel Glenn Jr. -LRB- July 18 , 1921 -- December 8 , 2016 -RRB- was a United States Marine Corps aviator , engineer , astronaut , and United States Senator from Ohio .	Ohio	Ohio	astronaut	astronaut	United States Marine Corps aviator	United States Marine Corps Aviation	engineer	engineer	United States Senator	United States Senate	Marine Corps	United States Marine Corps
In 1962 he was the first American to orbit the Earth , circling it three times .

Before joining NASA , Glenn was a distinguished fighter pilot in World War II and Korea with six Distinguished Flying Crosses and eighteen clusters on his Air Medal .	World War II	World War II	Air Medal	Air Medal	NASA	NASA	fighter pilot	fighter pilot	Korea	Korean War	Distinguished Flying Crosses	Distinguished Flying Cross (United States)	clusters	Oak leaf cluster
He was one of the Mercury Seven , military test pilots selected in 1959 by NASA as the United States ' first astronauts .	NASA	NASA	Mercury Seven	Mercury Seven
On February 20 , 1962 , Glenn flew the Friendship 7 mission ; the first American to orbit the Earth , he was the fifth person in space .	Friendship 7	Mercury-Atlas 6

He received the NASA Distinguished Service Medal , the Congressional Space Medal of Honor in 1978 , was inducted into the U.S. Astronaut Hall of Fame in 1990 , and was the last surviving member of the Mercury Seven . After Glenn resigned from NASA in 1964 and retired from the Marine Corps the following year , he planned to run for a U.S. Senate seat from Ohio .	Ohio	Ohio	NASA	NASA	Marine Corps	United States Marine Corps	U.S. Senate seat from Ohio	List of United States Senators from Ohio
An injury in early 1964 forced his withdrawal , and he lost a close primary election in 1970 .	primary election	Primary elections in the United States

A member of the Democratic Party , Glenn first won election to the Senate in 1974 and served for 24 years until January 3 , 1999 . In 1998 , still a sitting senator , Glenn was the oldest person to fly in space as a crew member of the Discovery space shuttle and the only person to fly in both the Mercury and Space Shuttle programs .
He received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2012 .	Presidential Medal of Freedom	Presidential Medal of Freedom
